coverage_notes: Completed 12 bounded targeted web searches covering only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss or closure; canceled/suspended emergency food distributions from storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction; and official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions with immediate access consequences. No new qualifying U.S. signal was identified in the prior-hour window. A fresh Kauai hurricane-recovery update was reviewed and excluded because North Shore Food Pantry distribution was explicitly proceeding as scheduled. Routine program promotion, generic SNAP policy coverage, stale events, non-U.S. results, resource guides, and unrelated closures were excluded.
